features.text: Knee orthosis, immobilizer, canvas longitudinal, prefabricated, off-the-shelf

indications: Pre and post surgical knee immobilization
measurement: Stand or sit with your leg straight. Measure the distance from your upper thigh to just above the ankle to determine the appropriate immobilizer length. Measure around the widest part of your thigh to confirm the circumference falls within the 10.25 in. to 26.5 in. range. Select the immobilizer length (12 in. to 24 in.) that provides adequate coverage for your condition. If between lengths, select the longer option for greater immobilization. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
